items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: She always gets on the radio, on the television, you know, if you're seeing that. She was another one who played with, you know, sang with all of them, Lizzie Miles. And this, yeah, he played with your daddy too.

ctx.x: He'll get that out. He'll get that out. He'll get that out. He'll get that out. He'll get that out. He'll get that out. He played a lot of the tunes you said. Pete Fountain plays a lot of the tunes that you heard in those days, huh? Yeah. And he plays plenty of them pieces.

We had a lot of them pieces he plays, you know. That was a great number. Well, Lizzie Miles sings that all the time, that song, Bill Bailey, Won't You Please Come Home. She always gets on the radio, on the television, you know, if you're seeing that. She was another one who played with, you know, sang with all of them, Lizzie Miles. And this, yeah, he played with your daddy too. What do you call this other fella? Humphrey.
